name: Macro-tile Rasterization
definition: A rasterization pipeline that replaces the standard four-stage per-tile gaussian list materialization (bitmask generation, counting, prefix sum, fill) with inline visibility determination during the gaussian load phase.
summary: Macro-tile Rasterization is a GPU technique for 3D Gaussian Splatting that replaces standard per-tile materialization with inline visibility determination during Gaussian loading, grouping tiles into macro-tiles to decouple work distribution and stabilize frame times at high resolutions.
